list: the official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18 and live on PlayStation and Xbox data on 2026-11-19
list_note: Rockstar, Sony and Microsoft published no official list before launch. The 55 names, descriptions and grades below are the list Exophase and PSNProfiles carried before this guide was written, the two agreeing on every name, description and grade; TrueAchievements and TrueTrophies list the same 55 live on launch day, 19 November 2026. Five trophies were still 'unknown' to every published guide on 18 November 2026; this guide says so plainly instead of guessing.

powerpyx.label: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

leonidahub.label: Leonida Hub: 55 trophies confirmed live (19 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed: every trophy is offline single-player. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 in difficulty and about 200 hours to the platinum, in a single playthrough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing. Play the story and it comes to you.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks after you finish Chapter 1, when the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks after you finish Chapter 2, when the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks after you finish Chapter 3, once you have completed the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks after you finish Chapter 4, when you complete its final main mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you complete the story's final mission. Nothing after it can be missed: the game returns you to free-roam, and everything needed for the platinum is still available there.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Just play the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, and the whole endgame. The 100% Completion Checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion; progress you made during the story already counts. The requirements are lenient, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, collectibles are only partly needed, and you need any 70 of 80 challenges, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, and any 100 optional missions. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and everything is still doable in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four kinds however you like: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under the bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past this one. Under the Bridges are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts; the map's Exploration list also shows each stunt by name.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types once. View them under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball (scoring hoops), playing a Video Game, winning a Car Race, Race Challenge or Top Fun Drone Race, and performing a Stunt. Most are introduced by the story or marked when you unfog the map, and you will do one of each naturally while working on the other trophies, so do not chase this one early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. The gold-medal scores are not too hard, and the ranges also level up your Focus, which the Gunslinger trophy needs. PowerPyx lists every range and challenge.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). Each location counts once you have won a race there, so you do not need to win every race, just one per location. PowerPyx lists all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Each race location counts once, so spread your wins around instead of repeating the same race. PowerPyx lists all 40 race locations.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge he sets.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable at the TV in your home from Chapter 1, by interacting with the controllers; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game, finish all of its levels at least once. You do not need to beat every challenge, and any of the four counts, so pick the one you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address in Belville. Complete her five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. Every quest is still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams. He calls you, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks shipwreck treasure locations with purple chest icons; dive down, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks across his sets of quests. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. Kenton goes quiet for a while in Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 to 3; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. Every quest is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Confirmed counting strands are Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing and mentoring), and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more strangers still being found. Check your count on the trophy tracker in the trophy list, and keep playing strangers after the story, they are all still there in free-roam.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered; the Zorrusso counts as the first. Track them under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is wanted, then drive it to his garage, marked by a green RK icon in west Vice City. Cars in good condition pay more, and the east of Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach is a good hunting ground. Everything here is still doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs around Vice City; go and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy. All of it is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate as Lucia and as Jason at each spot, which counts twice at the same location. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE, the only trophy flagged so by PowerPyx: one meditation exists only in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. It raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot, so it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy. PowerPyx did it and earned the trophy. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. Playing as Jason, you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County; Lucia cannot receive it, so this line is Jason only. Bret marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck. Which exact animal unlocks this trophy was still being confirmed when the guide was written.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards are found around Leonida; you only need three full sets, not all eighteen. PowerPyx lists every card set location.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations by holding Up and then R1 on objects in the environment. There are more than 100, and any 100 count: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel and it fills up on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this one pops on the way there. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; leave this for the end, then pick the easiest ones you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Do this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together; call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. The easiest escape is a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: the cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, because the large bank vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Do this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, with your partner called in (hold Right, press Triangle). Rob 3 robbery targets, the green icons on the map, in a row while the police chase you the whole time, keeping the red and blue flashing wanted level rather than the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop; if it does not, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles out of the 557 at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). Use the WAiNK app from your phone, hold Up to open it instantly, then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. You need 200 base-model vehicles scanned for the 100% checklist, so this trophy pops on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar at the top left. It only lasts a few seconds, so buff your focus first with food and drinks or a shower at home, and take Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it. Line up 5 enemies, such as the criminals at a gang operation, and drop them fast without missing; an assault rifle like the Duke 556 works best. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game and may pop naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at one of the departure terminals at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. It must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is at departure terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and take the stairs next to the boarding bridge, which lead straight inside. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The unlock is slightly delayed.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. Find them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun, for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons in unfogged map areas. Enter a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door, which would trip the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which is marked automatically from story progress: tail a security van to a bank, wait while a guard carries a briefcase of cash in and the vault opens, slip in and rob it. Bring your partner, you cannot carry all the cash alone, and hand off a bag by holding Right. After that quest you can pay Yasmani, the fence from Chapter 3, $10,000 per tip about security vans; finish his Payday Loans quests first if he is not selling tips yet. Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs; the 100% checklist needs all 8. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle through traffic, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. Each bank pays up to $205,000, the best money in the endgame.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck. To get it earlier, watch for armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the red heat radius. Find sticky bombs in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani is unlocked as a fence in the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map, all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx has a guide to the best plane and route for unfogging the map fast.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this trophy pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs: scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown as of 18 November 2026, and no other published guide pins it down either. The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so it is likely a small location interaction, but no verified steps exist yet. This guide will not guess: check the PowerPyx guide again after launch week, when the method should be confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown as of 18 November 2026, and no other published guide pins it down either. The description points at smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but no verified steps exist yet. This guide will not guess: check the PowerPyx guide again after launch week.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the gang operations in Port Gellhorn. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first, you need them to destroy the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, take the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the office in the north-east hallway by blowing it up with sticky bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. Killing the enemies is not needed. It is not missable: if you miss an item, wait until the robbery icon respawns, then go back and steal what is left.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then scroll to Strength, the heart icon. You can only start after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out: buy a membership at a fitness club, found by filtering the map by Activities, the dumbbell icon. Always bring your partner, hold Right and press Triangle to call them, because while one character works out the other trains automatically, doubling your progress. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. PlayStation tracks the count; click the trophy in the trophy list to see how many of 500 you have done. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence and clean escapes push you toward Professional; incapacitating enemies without killing them is Hardened; killing is Violent; killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones, is Psycho; keep going and the status becomes Irredeemable, which is permanent and makes cops more aggressive. It comes passively while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist. If you still need some at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown as of 18 November 2026. The going belief is that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but that is unconfirmed, a lead only, not a method. This guide will not present a guess as a fact: check the PowerPyx guide again after launch week.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown as of 18 November 2026. The going belief is that it comes from a UFO questline, but that is unconfirmed, a lead only, not a method. This guide will not present a guess as a fact: check the PowerPyx guide again after launch week.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET KNOWN. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown as of 18 November 2026. The going belief is that it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, but that is unconfirmed, a lead only, not a method. This guide will not present a guess as a fact: check the PowerPyx guide again after launch week.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check, meeting Raul's crew, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, you do not need to bring it at once. It comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist, and the large bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, though they only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the most expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. Leonida has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so the money goes quickly once you start buying.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, $160,000 in total. The 4 story-related garages do not count. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver, stealing the Crawler for Moses; you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. Robberies are the quick way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses, taking a vehicle to Moses. It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. Buy garages first, each one adds parking spots to register more vehicles, see Little Boxes. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and then Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
